items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I put him back in the band.

ctx.x: Do you remember? Oh, I don't know. No, that's why I don't know when Bob started. I really don't know. You know his daddy's good. Yeah. You know when he plays daddy's the old drummer.
I was going to ask you, do you remember when Joe Walken came back into the Lewis band when you was out in the West Coast? Was it?
I put him back in the band. Yeah.
